tools.name: sdbe_export
tools.description: Batch Export: Export many objects to separate files all at once. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: sdbe_list_add
tools.description: Add Selected: Add selected objects to the export list. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: sdbe_list_add_collection
tools.description: Add Collection: Add active collection to the export list, only supports 1 active collection at a time :( sry. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: sdbe_clear_list
tools.description: Clear List: Remove all objects from the export list. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
